transcript: Speaker A: Suno, kya tumhe bhi English bolne ka darr sataata rehta hai? Par yeh darr tumhe bohot peeche kar dega. RIVA ke saath daily practice karke tum apne ENGLISH ke darr ko hamesha ke liye mita sakte ho, aur apni DREAMS ko achieve kar sakte ho. PW Talk App download karo aur fluent English bolna seekho. on_screen_text: Suno, kya tumhe bhi English bolne ka darr satata rehta hai... PW TALK App par... Ismein RIVA AI partner hai... Sirf ’7 mein [Listen, does the fear of speaking English haunt you... on PW TALK App... It has RIVA AI partner... For just ’7]
summary: The ad addresses the fear of speaking English, positioning the PW Talk App and its AI partner RIVA as an affordable alternative to expensive coaching.
